## What and why

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Validation

List exact checks performed, their results, and anything not verified.
For visual changes, include a terminal capture using invented conversations.

## Before submitting

- [ ] Reproductions, fixtures, logs, and screenshots contain no real histories, secrets, or private paths.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests are included; deliberate snapshot changes were inspected.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded under Unreleased; no release/version bump is included unless agreed.
- [ ] Imported code/assets have an identified license and retained notices.
